locations.name: Minamitorishima (Marcus Island)
locations.settlement: No separate civilian settlement or community is established by the audited sources. JMA says the meteorological station is continuously staffed; mapping also depicts government facilities and an airfield. Facility staffing does not establish a settlement. Community/resident status remains unresolved.
locations.geometry: Existing candidate uses OSM coastline way 130970566 v27 and subtracts one mapped reservoir ring; prior source calculation is approximately 1.455657 km2. This is source evidence, not an approval to alter geometry.
locations.political_and_historical: Do not infer geographic tier from Japanese administration or ownership. No historical ownership or culture claims transferred.
locations.assessment: Location identity and whole-island granularity supported; local area/province semantics unresolved pending cross-region archipelago source review.

cross_region_finding.interpretive_limits: A direct named relation membership is evidence of an OSM grouping, not proof that the physical island belongs to that archipelago. Conversely it cannot be ignored when asserting a detached singleton local group. Administrative relations 8004038 (boundary=administrative, admin_level=8) and 8004037 (land_area=administrative) are separate and cannot decide physical grouping.
cross_region_finding.requested_follow_up: Jointly review the retained OSM relation against authoritative physical/naming sources and both regional assessments; decide whether source aggregation is unsuitable for parent inference, represents a physical grouping, or requires another sourced treatment. Preserve the published release until joint assessment; no unilateral boundary or membership edit.
